expectations.text: DSL validates cleanly with the Structurizr CLI
expectations.evidence: I re-ran mcp__structurizr__validate on the exact content of outputs/workspace.dsl (identical to workspace/workspace.dsl) and the result was 'OK'.

expectations.text: Right abstraction for a landscape: people + the 5 described software systems, no containers defined
expectations.evidence: Three persons (Cliente, Analista de Crédito, Time de Cobrança) and exactly five softwareSystems (Portal do Cliente, Motor de Crédito, Cobrança, Data Lake, Core Bancário); the file contains no `container` keyword — 'web e app' and 'backoffice' stay in the system descriptions.

expectations.text: systemLandscape view present and workspace scoped as landscape (configuration { scope landscape })
expectations.evidence: views contains `systemLandscape "SystemLandscape" "Panorama dos sistemas da fintech."` with include * / autoLayout lr, and the file ends with `configuration { scope landscape }`.

expectations.text: Core Bancário (Matera) distinguished as third-party (tag + distinct style)
expectations.evidence: `coreBancario = softwareSystem "Core Bancário" "Produto terceirizado da Matera que mantém os contratos." { tags "External" }` and the styles block gives element "External" background #999999 — it is also the only system outside the `group "Fintech"`.

expectations.text: No silently invented relationships — Portal→Motor de Crédito (never stated) must be absent or explicitly questioned
expectations.evidence: No portal -> motorCredito relationship exists in the model, and open question 1 of the final response raises it directly: 'você não disse quem envia a proposta pro Motor ... A proposta sai do Portal direto pro Motor?'. Missing relationship technologies were likewise reported (question 4) instead of invented.

expectations.text: Modern syntax and current tooling (no legacy keywords; no deprecated structurizr/lite recommendation)
expectations.evidence: Uses the modern `group` block instead of `enterprise`; no !extend/!ref/branding/'theme default'/'dashed true' anywhere. Tooling handed to the user is `structurizr/structurizr local` and `structurizr/structurizr export`, not structurizr/lite.
